title: Affine polynomial solution cover for Frobenius equations
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], p a prime with p=0 in Γ(X,O_X), n a natural number, c an n-by-n matrix and b an n-tuple over Γ(X,O_X). There exist an affine scheme P, an etale surjective map π:P→X [def-weil-etale-morphism], and sections y_i satisfying sum_j π*(c_ij)y_j^p-y_i=π*(b_i). For every scheme T→X and solution tuple z in Γ(T,O_T)^n, there is a unique map T→P over X pulling y back to z. This includes n=0 and the empty affine scheme.

proof.text: Form the explicit quotient B=A[X_1,...,X_n]/(b_i+X_i-sum_j c_ij X_j^p). Its naive square Jacobian matrix is the identity since p=0 in A; hence Spec B→Spec A is etale by the square-Jacobian criterion. Transport along X≅Spec Γ(X).

For each prime q of A, take an algebraic closure K of its residue field. The specialized matrix defines a p-semilinear map on K^n. Lang--Steinberg solves F(x)-x=b, giving B→K. The kernel prime lies over q, proving surjectivity, including the vacuous zero-ring case.

Evaluation at any solution tuple annihilates the displayed ideal and thus factors uniquely through B. The Spec/global-sections adjunction gives the unique morphism T→Spec B. Equality on constants and variables proves uniqueness, and the images of the variables give the universal solution.

lean.statement:
theorem frobenius_polynomial_solution_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hp : (p : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → Fin n → Γ(X, ⊤)) (b : Fin n → Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    ∃ (P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ X) (x : Fin n → Γ(P, ⊤)),
      IsAffine P ∧ Etale π ∧ Surjective π ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, π.appTop (c i j) * x j ^ p - x i = π.appTop (b i)) ∧
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (f : T ⟶ X) (y : Fin n → Γ(T, ⊤)),
        (∀ i, ∑ j, f.appTop (c i j) * y j ^ p - y i = f.appTop (b i)) →
        ∃! g : T ⟶ P, g ≫ π = f ∧ ∀ i, g.appTop (x i) = y i
